findings.title: Making `.small-action` a flex container stops the button's `float: right` from working.
findings.body: After this change, `.small-action` is a flex container. Floats have no effect on flex items, so the `float: right` on `.small-action button` and the `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` are ignored. `.small-action-desc` has no `flex-grow`, so it is only as wide as its text. As a result, the action button (for example, the delete or edit control on a small-action post) sits right after the description text instead of at the right edge of the row. To fix it, give the button `margin-left: auto`, or give `.small-action-desc` `flex: 1`, so the button stays on the right.
